player_prompt.intro:
I ye kono dɛ ka sɛnɛ {num_buttons} sɛnɛw: {buttons}. Kono sɛnɛ kɛcogo Bernoulli lakodɔnɛ lajɛlen ye, nka a jɛlen fɔlɔ don o fɛ; sɛnɛw jɛlenw ye to kelen ye.
Kono sɛnɛ kɔ, ni i bɔra, i bɛna sɔrɔdɔn ye ka na sɛnɛ lakodɔnɛ la.
I bɛ {num_turns} wakati dɔw la, ni kɔnɔ wakati dɔ kɔ, i bɛ se ka sɛnɛ wɛɛ kɛ i jɛ ka sɔrɔdɔn ye.
I lakɔli ye ka sɛnɛw jɛ ka wakati kɔ kɛɛ kɔ sɔrɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni sɛnɛ jɛlen ye ka bɔ sɛnɛ wɛɛ kɛ i nɔfɛ {num_turns} wakati dɔw la.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O tigi ma jaabili ɲuman di.

game_action.pressed: I bɔra {button} sɛnɛ ka sɔrɔdɔn ye ka na {reward} sɔrɔdɔn.

game_message.final_decision: I ka wari bena kɛ min o min ye, wagati ta ka miiri koɲuman k'a filɛ fɛɛn minw be se ka fisaya.
